reason: Fifty bucks plus thirteen for shipping is way too much for a water bottle, and the only way to make it reasonable is signing up for another filter subscription, which I've sworn off after getting burned before.
objection: The cheap price is locked behind a subscription, and I don't trust 'cancel any time' until I've actually tried to cancel one.
would_change_my_mind: A bottle under $35 with free shipping and filters I can buy one-off as I need them, no plan required.
